curriculum.description: Soft curriculum: CE/KD task loss is not removed during warmup. It starts at curriculum_min_task_weight and increases to 1.0.

theoretical_energy.note: Theoretical energy estimate in pJ/sample. Attention remains ANN and uses MAC cost. Only implicit SNN FFN layers use AC cost scaled by measured firing rate and average equilibrium steps. This is not actual GPU energy.

note: Tier 3 full two-stage hybrid implicit PhoBERT-SNN KD. Stage 1 checkpoint is loaded from stage1_wiki_implicit.py. Stage 2 uses task-based internal KD with embedding alignment and soft curriculum, followed by prediction-layer distillation.
